coverageLabel: Showing 5 trends from the top 20 today and week repositories.

rows.name: Developer and research automation tooling
rows.description: These repositories build automation for research, notifications, token usage, and code-related workflow support rather than end-user applications.

repos.name: PRAXIST
repos.description: Autonomous research system for measurable, computer-executable research.

repos.name: darwin-vm
repos.description: Run iOS/ macOS in Qemu. Virtual iPhone 17, 16, 15, 14, 13, 12 and M5-M1 Apple Si Macs supported.

repos.name: boop
repos.description: A tiny, self-hosted notification inbox for developers. Something happened in one of your apps; Boop tells you on your phone.

repos.name: cizgile
repos.description: cizgile — Zero-dependency URL slug engine. RFC 3986/3987 slugs, transliteration for 7 scripts, Unicode slugs, IRI ↔ URI, percent-encoding. Pure TypeScript, works everywhere.

repos.name: no-theo-license
repos.description: A permissive software license for almost everyone.

rows.name: Agent skill stacks and Claude/Codex workflows
rows.description: A cluster of repositories packages reusable skills, routing, and orchestration around Claude Code, Codex, and other agent runtimes.

repos.name: codex-with-chatgpt
repos.description: ChatGPT thinks. Codex works. Use ChatGPT as the planning brain while keeping the Codex harness.

repos.name: sepia
repos.description: De-AI writing skill for any Agent Skills-compatible agent (77+ via the Skills CLI), with native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, and Antigravity. Narrative-architecture repair for fiction, venue-matched rules for professional prose. Based on StoryScope (arXiv:2604.03136).

repos.name: headcount
repos.description: An agent organization for Claude Code, structured as a company — 15+ departments, 125+ skills, each independently installable.

repos.name: tokentab
repos.description: A CLI that reads Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI session logs and works out how much they cost, by model, project, and day.

repos.name: my-free-code
repos.description: Open-source multi-provider AI gateway for Claude Code and other coding agents, with model routing, streaming, tools, reasoning, fallbacks, and local model support

repos.name: refactoring-ui-skill
repos.description: A Claude Code skill that applies the concrete design rules from the book Refactoring UI (Wathan & Schoger) — constrained spacing/type/color/shadow scales, hierarchy through weight and color, and depth through emulated light — to building and fixing interfaces.

repos.name: opengrok
repos.description: Run any model in Grok Bot — one-command setup, model picker UI, evidence-based provider wire maps, and an update-proof doctor. Not farming you, arming you.

repos.name: hello-sdd
repos.description: Curso de SDD (Spec-Driven Development) desde cero

repos.name: skill-router
repos.description: Deterministic, private-by-default skill routing before the main LLM runs. Built by VEDAXI.

repos.name: Wonder-Pill
repos.description: A Claude skill that turns brainstorming into an interactive mind map of inverted assumptions — no answers, no ranking, just provocations.

rows.name: AI media generation and creative editing
rows.description: Several projects center on generating or editing audio, image, and video content with AI-assisted creative pipelines.

repos.name: open-higgsfield
repos.description: A studio for image and video generation — one prompt bar, each model’s own settings, and every finished run in one gallery.

repos.name: Concat
repos.description: Free & Open-Source CapCut replacement. (formerly WolfCut)

repos.name: shrimply
repos.description: you're telling me a shrimp made this video?

repos.name: DreamX-Creator
repos.description: Democratizing Native Audio-Video Generation at 2K Resolution

rows.name: Desktop apps and system-level media/runtime tools
rows.description: A separate group delivers cross-platform desktop applications or runtime-level utilities for music, virtual machines, rendering, and graphics enhancement.

repos.name: fastpotify
repos.description: Spotify, native and fast. One lightweight Rust app for your whole library, local playback, and Spotify Connect on Linux, macOS, and Windows.

repos.name: DLSS5-Feeder
repos.description: DLSS 5 neural rendering in D3D11/D12/Vulkan games that ship without any DLSS — feeds a synthetic DLAA contract (ReShade depth + motion vectors) to the DLSS 5 add-on via a private D3D12 device.

rows.name: Crypto analytics, wallet, and blockchain desktop utilities
rows.description: Many repositories focus on Windows or desktop tools for wallet recovery, portfolio tracking, tax/export workflows, ABI inspection, and other crypto operations.

repos.name: metamask-desktop
repos.description: 🌐 🔌 The MetaMask desktop app enables browsing Ethereum blockchain enabled websites

repos.name: walletgen
repos.description: WalletGen - Seed Phrase generator / checker for Bitcoin (BTC) and ETH (Ethereum) wallets. Find or recovery your wallet via brute force and brain wallet generation

repos.name: Exchange-Rate-Monitor
repos.description: Mempool Transaction Monitor — Windows monitoring concept for observing public pending-transaction feeds and mempool statistics.

repos.name: Blockchain-Tax-Exporter
repos.description: Crypto Cost Basis Calculator — Windows finance utility concept for local crypto accounting, cost-basis, gain/loss, and tax-report preparation from imported data.

repos.name: HD-Wallet-Scanner
repos.description: Multi Exchange CSV Merger — Windows data utility concept for importing, normalizing, validating, and converting crypto or exchange CSV exports.

repos.name: DCA-Strategy-Planner
repos.description: Token Allowance Checker — Windows read-only concept for reviewing public token approvals and allowance records without wallet signing.

repos.name: Mining-Pool-Dashboard
repos.description: ABI Decoder Desktop — Windows developer utility concept for encoding, decoding, and inspecting smart-contract ABI data locally.

repos.name: Hashpower-Calculator
repos.description: Contract Function Viewer — Windows developer utility concept for inspecting smart-contract calls, logs, events, receipts, and public metadata.

repos.name: Retroactive-Drop-Finder
repos.description: Historical Crypto Price Downloader — Windows market-data concept for viewing, importing, converting, and exporting historical asset price information.

repos.name: NFT-Collection-Scanner
repos.description: Blockchain API Monitor — Windows API diagnostics concept for testing blockchain-related REST endpoints and inspecting structured responses.

repos.name: DeFi-Reward-Harvester
repos.description: NFT Metadata Inspector — Windows read-only concept for inspecting NFT transfers, token metadata, and collection data from public sources.
